common.linkCopy: Button not working? Paste this into your browser:
common.securityNoticeReason: You're getting this because a ReactionLab account uses this address. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

repeatedRegistration.title: Someone tried to sign up with your email
repeatedRegistration.attempt: Someone just tried to create a ReactionLab account with {email}. You already have an account with this address, so nothing was created and nothing about your account changed.
repeatedRegistration.ifItWasYou: If it was you, sign in instead. Forgotten your password? The sign-in page can send you a link to reset it.
repeatedRegistration.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't you, you don't need to do anything. Your account is safe, and nobody can use your address for another ReactionLab account.

emailConfirmation.title: Confirm your email address
emailConfirmation.ownership: Confirm that {email} is yours, and you can sign in and start experimenting.
emailConfirmation.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
emailConfirmation.ifItWasNotYou: Didn't sign up? Ignore this email. Nobody can sign in with this address until it's confirmed.
emailConfirmation.reason: You're getting this because someone signed up for ReactionLab with this address.

passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.request: Someone, hopefully you, asked to reset the password of your ReactionLab account.
passwordReset.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. Choosing a new password signs you out on every device.
passwordReset.ifItWasNotYou: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email: your password stays the same, and nobody can use the link without this mailbox.
passwordReset.reason: You're getting this because someone asked to reset the password of the ReactionLab account at this address. It's a security email, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.

passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.changed: The password of your ReactionLab account was just changed, and every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.ifItWasYou: If this was you, there's nothing else to do.
passwordChanged.ifItWasNotYou: If it wasn't, reset your password now. The link in that email signs out whoever changed it.
passwordChanged.reset: It wasn't me: reset my password
passwordChanged.reason: You're getting this because the password of the ReactionLab account at this address changed. It's a security notice, so it's sent even when you turn other emails off.
